title: Data Analytics Intern
desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
As a Data Analytics Intern, you will support business intelligence, reporting, data management, and analytics initiatives within Medtronic Türkiye. This role offers hands-on experience in data analysis, dashboard development, performance reporting, and business planning activities. Working closely with the Data Analytics team, you will help transform data into actionable insights that support business decision-making.
Internship Details
Start date: December 2026
Location: Istanbul, Türkiye
Duration: 6 months (with possibility to extend)
Working hours: 40 hours/week
Work model: hybrid (3 days per week in the office)
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Collect, organize, validate, and maintain business and commercial datasets.
Support the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, and analytical tools, including Power BI dashboards where required.
Perform data quality checks and ensure data accuracy across reporting systems.
Analyze business performance trends and provide actionable insights to support decision-making.
Support automation and process improvement initiatives, as well as ongoing digital transformation and data governance activities.
Prepare presentations and summaries for business reviews and leadership discussions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams on analytics and reporting requests.
Required Knowledge and Skills:
Final-year student or recent graduate in Data Analytics, Statistics, Biomedical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Economics, or a related field
Fluency in Turkish and good command of English (at least B2 upper-intermediate level)
Proficiency in MS Excel, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Eagerness to learn and work in a data-driven environment
Would be a plus:
Familiarity with Power BI, SQL, Python, or other data visualization tools
Physical Job Requirements
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.
If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com.
